    DealRules

    DealState

    LoginResult
    Outcome of AuthService.login(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.hkust.marketplace.models.UserRole).
    MyDealsService
    UC7 Manage My Deals, for the Buyer (Task 1.6): the buyer's current and completed deals, marking a purchase or claim complete, and returning a borrowed item before its due date.
    NotificationService
    Notifications for all three portals (UC4 View Notifications, shared by the User actor).
    OfferAction
    What each party can do with an offer now (assumptions register 71): the seller answers it on Manage Offers & Requests (3.3-3.5; Task 2.5), the only place where offers are answered: a Pending offer can be accepted, declined or countered, except that a claim cannot be countered; a Countered offer, waiting for the buyer, can still be declined.
    OfferForm
    What the Make Offer form starts with (UC5 steps 2-4), after the listing was found to be available.
    OfferService
    UC5 Make Offer, for the Buyer (Task 1.5): a price offer on a sale listing, a borrow request on a lend listing, or a claim on a giveaway.

    Hashes and verifies passwords so they are never stored in plaintext (UC1 Special Requirement 1, UC2 Special Requirement 1).
    PhotoService
    Adds listing photos (Create Listings step 8 and the admin's Manage Marketplace Listings: up to Listing.MAX_PHOTOS photos per listing).
    ProfileService

    ReportForm

    ReportService

    ReviewFilter

    ReviewForm
    What the review form shows (UC10 step 3), after the deal was found to be completed and not reviewed yet.
    ReviewService

    SellerOfferService

    SellerProfile
    A seller as buyers see them (UC8 A3; Task 1.10: "display the seller's average rating and reviews on their profile and on each of their listing detail pages").
    SellerRating
    One row of the Seller Ratings tab (Task 3.8, step 5): a seller with the rating data.
    SellerReviewService
